newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes rice.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes rice.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20, a company spokesman said on Sunday.
April 8 is the final date for bids and the result will be announced on April 16.
GEZA bought 12,000 tonnes of white rice on Wednesday from an Indian company at $383 per tonne, for delivery in April.
